params.caption: Ko'pchilik IELTS Speaking'da ham bexosdan shunday deydi: “I am agree”. Afsuski, bu xato 🙂 Sababi oddiy: agree o'zi fe'l, “rozi bo'lmoq, qo'shilmoq” degani. Xuddi “I am go” demaganimizdek, unga am, is, are kerak emas. Shunchaki I agree with you, ya'ni “siz bilan roziman”. Inkorda ham “I'm not agree” emas, I don't agree bo'ladi: I don't agree with this idea. Savolda esa Do you agree? deymiz. Uchinchi shaxsda -s ni unutmang: My teacher agrees that daily practice works. Speaking'da fikringizni kuchliroq aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, I completely agree yoki I couldn't agree more deb ko'ring. Ikkinchisi “bundan ortiq qo'shila olmayman”, ya'ni “mutlaqo roziman” degani va juda tabiiy eshitiladi. 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location
